text.en: Rides a Skateboard and carries a Very Heavy Melee Weapon of Poor Quality (ROF 1, 4d6).

summary.pt: Hiroki Nishioka, herdeiro da pesquisa da Kibble alternativa; os pais morreram num acidente de carro suspeito, que também custou o braço dele. Cuidadoso, evita chamar atenção para os poemas que escreve, mas se solta ao lado de Hi-Stick, Shredder e Tetra.
summary.en: Hiroki Nishioka, heir to the Kibble alternative research; his parents died in a suspicious car crash that also cost him an arm. Cautious, he avoids drawing attention to the poems he writes, but opens up around Hi-Stick, Shredder and Tetra.

text.pt: Medical Grade Cyberarm; vai de Bicycle e leva uma Heavy Pistol com munição Armor-Piercing.
text.en: A Medical Grade Cyberarm; rides a Bicycle and carries a Heavy Pistol with Armor-Piercing rounds.

summary.pt: Líder da Maelstrom depois da morte do fundador, Hammer, durante a "Nuke Frenzy" que se seguiu à queda da Arasaka Tower. Conduziu os sobreviventes até o Burleson Tower Hotel, mas em 2027 enlouqueceu, massacrou um comboio da StormTech e sumiu na Hot Zone. Reaparece de vez em quando como um deus furioso da gangue, ajudando-a em batalha ou espancando seus membros.
summary.en: Maelstrom's leader after founder Hammer died in the "Nuke Frenzy" that followed the fall of the Arasaka Tower. He led the survivors to the Burleson Tower Hotel, but in 2027 he went cyberpsychotic, slaughtered a StormTech convoy and vanished into the Hot Zone. He still shows up at random, like the gang's angry god, either joining its battles or beating its members.

Entrou criança na gangue sob Crusher e assumiu depois que Hextra morreu por um tiro de 30mm da MAX-TAC. Com Quake e Flenser, organiza os catadores da Hot Zone e escora a Totentanz.
summary.en: Current leader of Maelstrom, who looks like a disposable ganger but deals with Corp execs and plans long term. He joined as a kid under Crusher and took over after Hextra took a 30mm round from MAX-TAC. With Quake and Flenser he organized the Hot Zone scavengers and holds up Totentanz.

summary.en: A cyberpsycho kept in the sub-sub-basement of Burleson Tower, used by the gang for entertainment and punishment. It used to be human; it no longer seems so. Joe Pitt bolted a mask on it because eating victims made it sick. Nobody wins when thrown down there.

summary.pt: O "punho de ferro" da Maelstrom, um brutamontes cheio de chrome que obedece a Warlock e lidera tumultos contra os Inquisitors. Armadura reforçada, martelo gigante e revólver embutido; ele não só mata, aterroriza, e seu estilo está virando moda entre os mais novos.
summary.en: Maelstrom's "mailed fist", a heavily chromed brute who follows Warlock and leads riots against the Inquisitors. Reinforced frame, giant hammer and a built-in revolver; he does not just kill, he terrifies, and his style is spreading among the newer gangers.

Rabugento e com complexo de injustiçado, importa-se com a gangue; denuncia ciberpsicopatas a um policial para evitar a MAX-TAC.
summary.en: Maelstrom's engineer and tech lead, who keeps Burleson Tower standing with servo-hydraulic supports, installs Flenser's gadgets, maintains weapons and cyberware and tunes bikes. Sullen and aggrieved, he truly cares about the gang; he reports dangerous cyberpsychos to an NCPD officer to keep MAX-TAC away.

summary.en: A former Quake enforcer who now runs the Hot Zone scavver army. Sadistic, he lures kids with the promise of Maelstrom membership and invented ritual "Tests", and many never return. His body count could sink the gang or push him to split off.

summary.en: A mid-tier Maelstrom sniper, sibling of the Zoner FreeFall and raised in South Night City. Dresses like an old war vet and dreams of a Tsunami Arms RJ85 ramjet sniper rifle. A good shot, but with cheap gear and a mouth full of sniper slang.

summary.en: An Inquisitor infiltrator corrupted by Maelstrom: he stopped passing on information, got new arms, and now speaks of Quake's and Ripper's rituals as if they were sacred. He is low-level and friendless, a fresh convert and zealot.

summary.pt: Antigo catador de Hot Zone chamado Digger, que sobreviveu a radiação, desabamentos e nanoenxames e ganhou o nome depois de cozinhar e comer um monstro irradiado. No último Teste de Ripper, pescou uma faca num banho de alumínio derretido e ganhou um braço novo, a faca e a vaga na gangue.
summary.en: A former Hot Zone scavver named Digger who survived radiation, collapses and nanoswarm poisoning, and earned his name after cooking and eating an irradiated monster. In Ripper's final Test he fished a knife from molten aluminum, winning a replacement arm, the knife and membership.

summary.pt: Sargento franco-atirador da equipe TAC do Precinct #1, com 34 acertos em 36 disparos. Trabalha sem observador, o que viola a regra, e não tem avaliação psicológica no prontuário. A analista da Danger Gal liga a ele pelo menos doze assassinatos a longa distância sem solução e desconfia de um assassino infiltrado na polícia.
summary.en: A TAC sniper sergeant at Precinct #1 with 34 hits out of 36 shots. He works without a spotter, against policy, and has no psych evaluation in his file. The Danger Gal analyst ties him to at least a dozen unsolved long-range killings and suspects a hired assassin planted inside the police.

Quem atrapalha as investigações dele acaba barrado nas cenas de crime ou pior. O prontuário médico está censurado e há indício de um Agent com "programação terapêutica", sinal de que ele pode estar virando o que persegue.
summary.en: An incorruptible detective who hunts serial killers and likely cyberpsychos, and who never lets go of a case. Anyone interfering gets barred from crime scenes or worse. His medical file is redacted and hints at an Agent with "therapeutic programming", suggesting he may be turning into what he hunts.

summary.pt: Agente da Interpol destacado em Night City para casos de criminosos que cruzam fronteiras. Elegante e bom de câmera, faz acordos e troca informações quando lhe convém, e pode abastecer os PCs desde que recebam algo em troca. Corre o boato de que sumiu com alguns "problemas" a pedido dos superiores.
summary.en: An INTERPOL agent stationed in Night City for cases of criminals crossing borders. Slick and camera-ready, he cuts deals and trades data when it suits him, and can feed the PCs information for a favor in return. Rumor says he has quietly disposed of a few "problems" for his superiors.

summary.en: A lieutenant who leads Precinct #1's TAC Squad and runs the training himself, hence the handle. Cautious, he sizes up opponents before engaging, and his superiors call him insufficiently aggressive. MAX-TAC has offered him a job, but he thinks Hammerman is a traitor and has not answered.

Coopera com agências externas, mas só dentro da lei: ajuda numa troca de tiros e depois prende pelos danos. Seu ponto fraco é a dívida de jogo da esposa com o Fixer Rex Royale.
summary.en: An honest officer, widely admired by her colleagues, who is typically first on scene when an Officer Down call goes out. She works with outside agencies only within the law: she'll join a shootout, then book you for the damage. Her weak point is her wife's gambling debt to the Fixer Rex Royale.

Os superiores o tiraram da patrulha e o puseram em relações públicas, e ele faria qualquer coisa para voltar às ruas.
summary.en: A handsome adrenaline junkie cop who became a media darling through flashy rescues and firefights. He once had a synthcoke habit and his recklessness has endangered bystanders. His bosses pulled him off patrol into public relations, and he will do almost anything to get back on the street.

summary.pt: Sargento com mais de trinta anos de NCPD, anterior à Nuke, que protege seus policiais e faz favores de olho na aposentadoria. Recebe propina de gangues e Corps e desvia itens do depósito de provas. Para a Danger Gal é fonte paga, mas o abuso de Pitbull contra os Nomads Sightseers pode trazer retaliação e deixá-lo precisando de ajuda.
summary.en: A sergeant with over thirty years on the NCPD, predating the Nuke, who looks after his officers and trades favors with an eye on retirement. He takes payoffs from gangs and Corps and skims the evidence lockers. He is a paid Danger Gal source, but Pitbull's abuse of the Sightseers Nomads may bring retaliation and leave him in need of help.

Fecha-se com quase todos, mas ameaçar o cachorro diante dela é a pior ideia possível. É útil para achar esconderijos de armas e bombas.
summary.en: A widowed officer on one of Precinct #1's eight K-9 units, inseparable from her dog Gustav; she watches his camera through her Chyron and talks to him over her Agent. She is closed off with most people, but threatening the dog in front of her is the worst idea possible. She is useful for finding weapon caches and bombs.

Já tem advertências por força excessiva e ganhou cromo caro sem explicar como pagou, o que sugere dívidas ou ligação com a Red Chrome Legion. Espancou um Nomad Sightseer a mando de Sarge e deixou os Aldecaldos em pé de guerra.
summary.en: A recent graduate who joined the force to legally pound on people, and whose favorite job is riot duty. She already has excessive-force write-ups and got expensive chrome with no explanation, hinting at debts or ties to the Red Chrome Legion. She beat a Sightseers Nomad nearly to death on Sarge's orders and set the Aldecaldos on the warpath.

summary.pt: Novato recém-saído do treinamento da NCPD, idealista e cheio de ideias sobre "fazer a diferença". Patrulha o University District e já bateu de frente com seguranças particulares, o que pode se estender aos operativos da Danger Gal. Ainda dá para aproveitar o idealismo dele, desde que seja com incentivo e sem ameaça.
summary.en: A rookie fresh out of NCPD training, idealistic and full of notions about "making a difference". He patrols the University District and has already clashed with private security, which could extend to Danger Gal operatives. His idealism can still be put to use, but only with carrots rather than sticks.

summary.pt: Segurança de Fiona e ao mesmo tempo o responsável corporativo por ela, ex-agente de inteligência com passado nebuloso que a rede mantém abafado. Silencioso e profissional, vigia todos que se aproximam da equipe. Fiona e Stringer não sabem que ele mataria os dois sem hesitar para esconder a troca das Fionas.
summary.en: Fiona's bodyguard and also her corporate handler, a former intelligence operative whose murky past the network keeps buried. Quiet and professional, he tracks everyone who gets near the team. Neither Fiona nor Stringer knows he would shoot them without hesitation to keep the Fiona substitution secret.

summary.en: Fiona's cameraman and closest confidant for more than twenty years, moved off-camera because of weak ratings. He loved a previous Fiona, swore revenge for her death and stays with the network waiting for the right moment to expose the scheme. It is unclear which Fiona he will end up being loyal to.

Os contatos antigos dele deram a Corpse a base para montar o império das festas.
summary.en: The oldest active Piranha still alive, Corpse Reviver's right hand and head of security. Joe trains recruits to keep parties lively and safe and acts like a rough older sibling when anyone threatens the group. Joe's old contacts gave Corpse the foothold she needed to build her party empire.

Contadora excelente, trata os recrutas como a família maluca que ela mesma nunca teve.
summary.en: Leader of the Piranhas, with an uncertain past and probably a Combat Zone upbringing. She took over after her predecessor overdosed and merged other party gangs into an empire of drugs, drinks and security. A superb accountant, she treats her recruits as the messed-up family she never had.

summary.pt: Cozinheira e traficante da periferia que preferia fazer pessoas felizes a lucrar, até conhecer Corpse Reviver numa festa e entrar nas Piranhas sem perguntas. Hoje é a joia da gangue, e sua última criação, o Piranha Smash, é assunto na cidade. Cozinha qualquer coisa, sempre sorrindo.
summary.en: A cook and dealer on the city's edge who cared more about giving people joy than profit, until she met Corpse Reviver at a party and joined the Piranhas without asking questions. Now the gang's crown jewel, her latest creation, Piranha Smash, is the talk of town. She can make anything, and does it smiling.

summary.pt: Atirador certeiro de bom coração e armadura subdérmica, ex-segurança de uma gangue protetora de Santo Domingo. Acredita que as comunidades locais devem se abastecer e se policiar, e por isso leva cromo e armas recuperados do centro para os subúrbios pobres, via o Fixer Woodchipper. Foi o catalisador dos Sightseers e hoje está preso pela NCPD, espancado depois de ajudar Swirl.
summary.en: A kind-hearted crack shot in subdermal armor, once an enforcer for a guardian gang in Santo Domingo. He believes local communities should supply and police themselves, so he moves scavenged chrome and guns from downtown to the poor outskirts through the Fixer Woodchipper. He was the spark behind the Sightseers and is now in NCPD custody, beaten after helping Swirl.

summary.pt: Brutamontes de poucas palavras que ganhou o nome pelo cybereye com mira. Cuida da segurança dos Sightseers, acompanha cargas valiosas e solta o rifle quando Racer aponta um alvo. É leal ao grupo, mas tolera Endo e os outros só na superfície, e a prisão de Endo e Swirl pode mudar a opinião dele sobre a polícia.
summary.en: A big, taciturn enforcer who got his handle from a cybereye with a targeting scope. He handles Sightseers security, rides along with valuable cargo and unleashes his rifle when Racer points at a target. He is loyal to the Pack but barely tolerates Endo and the others, and the arrest of Endo and Swirl may change how he sees the police.

summary.pt: Fundadora e líder dos Sightseers, ex-edgerunner de escolta e extração que decidiu montar uma família do zero. Vive na Kombi e leva comida, remédios e equipamento médico entre Packs e Reclaimers, deixando as viagens fáceis para os mais novos. Ignora as cargas duvidosas dos companheiros desde que Corps e polícia fiquem longe.
summary.en: Founder and leader of the Sightseers, a former escort and extraction Edgerunner who chose to build a family from scratch. She lives in her Kombi and moves food, medicine and medical tech between Packs and Reclaimers, giving easy runs to the juniors. She looks away from her crew's shadier cargo as long as Corps and cops stay out.

summary.pt: Solo que perdeu os olhos para a Red Chrome Legion, trocou-os por cybereyes médicos e voltou horas depois para eliminar os captores com uma pistola de pinos. Passou a trabalhar como mercenário de aluguel e, depois de impressionar Racer contra scavs, virou membro dos Sightseers. Faz reconhecimento, cobertura e comunicação nas viagens.
summary.en: A Solo who lost his eyes to the Red Chrome Legion, swapped them for medical-grade cybereyes and came back within a day to pick off his captors with a bolt gun. He turned into a streetmerc and guard for hire, and after impressing Racer against scavs he became a full Sightseer. He scouts, provides overwatch and relays information during runs.

summary.pt: A caçula e mais recente dos Sightseers, ladra de coisas brilhantes que pulou de Pack em Pack sem se encaixar. Endo a ajudou a fugir da NCPD e a levou para o grupo como mentor, mas um furto numa entrega atraiu Sarge e levou os dois à prisão. Ganhou o apelido pelos padrões de suas Shift Tacts.
summary.en: The youngest and newest Sightseer, a thief of shiny things who drifted from Pack to Pack without fitting in. Endo helped her escape the NCPD and mentored her inside the group, but pocketing goods on a run drew Sarge's attention and landed both in custody. Her nickname comes from the swirling patterns of her Shift Tacts.

summary.pt: Netrunner imprevisível que começou com travessuras, evoluiu para hackear corporações e hoje vive de gigs para Fixers. Segue o próprio código ético, é leal a quem ama, sobretudo Nox, e anima o grupo. Ataca com lâminas e patins nos pés e é quem mais questiona os planos do Mr. Fixit.
summary.en: An erratic Netrunner who began with pranks, moved up to hacking Corporations, and now lives off Fixer gigs. He keeps to his own code, stays loyal to the people he loves (Nox above all) and lifts the crew's mood. He fights with blades and skate feet, and he's the likeliest to push back on Mr. Fixit's plans.

summary.pt: Filho de um líder guerrilheiro da Geórgia, treinado em guerra constante contra a SovOil e especialista em tiro de longa distância. Chegou a Night City após a queda da célula do pai e foi acolhido por Mr. Fixit, o "tio". Ainda é novato como edgerunner, e Paladin o chama de Red Shirt, mas já provou que prioriza vidas, até largando uma missão para levar uma mulher em trabalho de parto.
summary.en: Son of a Georgian insurgent leader, raised in constant war against SovOil and gifted with long-range firearms. He came to Night City after his father's cell fell and was taken in by Mr. Fixit, his "uncle". Still green as an Edgerunner, which earned him Paladin's nickname Red Shirt, he has shown he puts lives first, once leaving a job to get a woman in labor to a hospital.

summary.pt: Piloto e médico da Team Monster, vindo de uma equipe de salvage e da Trauma Team antes de virar edgerunner. É conhecido por tirar equipes de enrascadas e mantê-las vivas, e a sorte já salvou o grupo, como no voo sob fogo antiaéreo no assalto ao Anne Boleyn.
summary.en: The pilot and medic of Team Monster, who came from a salvage crew and Trauma Team before becoming an Edgerunner. Known for getting crews in and out and keeping them alive, his luck has saved the group before, as on the Anne Boleyn heist when anti-air fire nearly downed them.

summary.pt: Jovem Rockerboy em ascensão que toca em clubes famosos com um synth pop "extraterrestre" de shows alucinógenos. Fora do palco é mais humilde, e há suspeita de que a habilidade de coletar informações a levou ao radar de Mr. Fixit. Tem encanto para chegar a quase qualquer pessoa e é ligada a Cereal.
summary.en: A rising young Rockerboy who plays well-known clubs with an "extraterrestrial" synth pop and hallucinogenic shows. Off-stage she is humbler, and she probably caught Mr. Fixit's eye through her knack for gathering intel. She has the charm to reach almost anyone and is close to Cereal.

summary.pt: Veterano calado que saiu da Combat Zone, serviu a Militech e virou freelancer por mais dinheiro. Segue o plano à risca, sem emoção, e gosta de ver os mais novos errarem. Lidera o combate da Team Monster e é o "bastão" que os colegas ameaçam usar nos interrogatórios.
summary.en: A quiet veteran who climbed out of the Combat Zone, served Militech and went freelance for better pay. He follows the plan to the letter without emotion and enjoys watching the youngsters mess up. He runs point on Team Monster's combat ops and is the "stick" the crew threatens interrogations with.

summary.pt: Líder do esquadrão NC4-2, espanhola de uma família de caçadores de recompensa que a treinou em anatomia e combate. Foi mandada a Night City numa missão solo e sobreviveu à demolição do prédio onde se escondia, guiando os sobreviventes por um esgoto. A culpa de sobrevivente a transformou numa líder rápida e dedicada à equipe, talvez demais.
summary.en: Leader of Squad NC4-2, a Spaniard from a family of bounty hunters who taught her anatomy along with combat. Sent to Night City on a solo job, she survived the demolition of the building she was hiding in and led the survivors out through a sewer. Survivor's guilt made her a fast, team-devoted leader, perhaps to a fault.

Impressionado com o esquadrão que chegou atirando, procurou Paddles e conquistou Cazadora com entusiasmo, e é melhor que Paddles com as armas do AV.
summary.en: The squad's gunner, new to the team. He was unlucky hired muscle who fled a booster-gang turf war in North Heywood after attacking two targets who turned out to be cosplaying Execs. Awed by the squad that shot its way in, he tracked down Paddles and won Cazadora over with puppy enthusiasm, and he handles the AV's mounted weapons better than Paddles.

Filha de pais marroquinos e sobrinha de um gerente da Trauma Team, largou o treinamento com Paddles para ir à REO Meatwagon, voltando depois do desabamento do prédio. Deve muito a Cazadora e só confia na família, de sangue ou escolhida.
summary.en: The squad's medic, specializing in meat injuries. Daughter of Moroccan parents and niece of a Trauma Team manager, she quit training with Paddles to work for REO Meatwagon, then came back after the building collapse. She owes Cazadora a lot and trusts only family, by blood or by choice.

summary.pt: Irmão de Stick que trocou a medicina pela fama como repórter independente chamado Flashes. Expôs a piloto Rockabye por entregar os explosivos que derrubaram o prédio, sofreu dois atentados e fugiu para a Trauma Team com nova aparência, levando Rockabye consigo. Tem aptidão para reparos cibernéticos e acha corpos de carne nojentos.
summary.en: Stick's brother, who traded medicine for stardom as an independent reporter called Flashes. He exposed the pilot Rockabye for delivering the explosives that brought the building down, survived two assassination attempts and hid in Trauma Team under a new look, bringing Rockabye with him. He has a knack for cybernetic repair and finds meat bodies icky.

summary.pt: Piloto do esquadrão, da família Nomad Gavilan, que entregou os explosivos usados no desabamento e carrega a culpa disso. Raramente sai da Bay 4-2, cuida da manutenção do AV e dirige com suavidade para os feridos e agressividade rumo ao perigo. Segue pagando uma dívida de culpa e recusa propostas de outras equipes.
summary.en: The squad's pilot, from the Gavilan Nomad Pack, who delivered the explosives used in the collapse and carries the guilt of it. She rarely leaves Bay 4-2 except on calls, maintains the AV, and flies smoothly for casualties but dives into trouble spots like a demon. She is working off a debt of guilt and turns down offers from other crews.

text.en: She maintains the squad's SovOil Mi-60 (AV-4), rebuilt with Nomad parts, with NOS, a machine gun and a rocket pod (p.120). She uses an Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol and a Light Tattoo.

summary.pt: Especialista em desfibrilador que usa as pás como arma e adora derrubar obstáculos orgânicos. Convenceu Stick a ir para a REO Meatwagon e ficou com um bônus que ela nunca soube, e foi ele que provavelmente matou o chefe de turno Marek Lewis. Polonês de Cracóvia, simpático e bom de lábia, usa os resgates para vender contratos extras.
summary.en: A defibrillator specialist who uses the paddles as a weapon and enjoys flattening organic obstacles. He talked Stick into defecting to REO Meatwagon and kept a signing bonus she never knew about, and he likely killed the shift boss Marek Lewis. A Polish native of Krakow, friendly and silver-tongued, he signs casualties up for extra contracts during rescues.

summary.pt: Líder dos Tyger Claws, filho adotivo do ator Shinobu Nakagawa, que venceu a disputa pela herança e assumiu o nome do pai. Sem talento para o teatro Kabuki, faz das ruas o seu palco, com corpo cromado e desfiles que o tornam herói da juventude de Kabuki. Sua esposa Ryoko controla o dinheiro da Fundação, e ele sente o império escorrer e usa cibernéticos para aliviar a dor.
summary.en: Leader of the Tyger Claws and adopted son of the actor Shinobu Nakagawa, who won the inheritance fight and took his father's name. Lacking talent for Kabuki theater, he treats the streets as his stage, with a polished chrome body and parades that make him a hero to Kabuki youth. His wife Ryoko controls the Foundation's money, and he feels the empire slipping and numbs the pain with cybernetics.

Deve um favor ao Shinobu original e serve ao filho adotivo para pagá-lo. Um relatório da Danger Gal revela que foi assassino pessoal de Kei Arasaka e hoje vive como o monge Zenjyu-bou, com motivos desconhecidos.
summary.en: A helmeted sniper who guards Shinobu the Second from Kabuki's rooftops while the leaders never learn his identity. He owes a debt to the original Shinobu and serves the adopted son to repay it. A Danger Gal source reveals he was one of Kei Arasaka's personal assassins and now lives as the monk Zenjyu-bou, with unknown motives.

Filho de veteranos do Tyger's Claw original, é um dos mais confiáveis de Shinobu the Second e ignora quem queria vê-lo no comando. Os pais aposentados, leais à Arasaka, doutrinam os netos em segredo.
summary.en: Captain of the Kimen-Gumi, the Tyger Claws' internal police force. He wears a red mask and leads steadily, with none of his boss's flair. Son of veterans from the original Tyger's Claw, he is among Shinobu the Second's most trusted allies and brushes off those who wanted him in charge. His retired parents, still Arasaka loyalists, quietly pass their ideology on to their grandchildren.

O marido morreu defendendo a casa na briga pela herança e Hayato a fez membro dos Tyger Claws por obrigação. Hoje confidente de Ryoko Fujiwara, recusa o convite para trabalhar na Fundação.
summary.en: A Kiroshi lab medtech born in Kansai, widow of Hiroto Miyamoto, childhood friend of Hayato Nakagawa. Her husband died defending their home in the inheritance fight, and Hayato made her a Tyger Claws member whether she liked it or not. Now a confidant of Ryoko Fujiwara, she has declined an offer to join the Foundation.

summary.en: Boss of the Tekiya, Kabuki's street vendors, and a veteran cook of classic Japanese street food. He trains apprentices, and the Claws' Fixers demand his seal for any new stall. A devout Buddhist, a gossip and old-school yakuza in temperament, he insists on loyalty and obligation from anyone who passes his tests.

summary.en: A young Kimen-Gumi Hanmen in Burai's squad, raised in his family's pachinko parlor in Kabuki. He regards the Tyger Claws as a local neighborhood club, knows the locals and spots strangers. Unmasked he looks like a J-pop idol, and his friendliness disarms people who fear the Kimen-Gumi.

summary.en: A Matsura Food Products salesman and clever Fixer who walks a careful line between the Tyger Claws and his employer. He imports goods for the Night Markets and online auctions and fakes otaku credentials to impress posergangs, without success. Continental Brands is threatening him and he is looking for a way out.

Admira lendas da espada, treina no dojo avançado Tora-no-Ana e é visto como irmão mais novo, mas ninguém se apega, pois sempre há outro aprendiz para substituí-lo.
summary.en: A teenage swordsman recruited from the Tyger Dojo and sponsored from Old Japantown to Kabuki, nicknamed "new rice" until he survives a year. He admires legendary swordsmen, trains at the advanced dojo Tora-no-Ana and is seen as a little brother, but nobody bonds, since another recruit can always replace him.

summary.pt: Solo de identidade, gênero e financiamento desconhecidos, que opera em Night City há cinco anos e exige em contrato que o cliente nunca revele seu nome. Faz extrações, assassinatos dirigidos e recuperações para todas as grandes Corps, mata o alvo, santo ou pecador, e poupa civis. Pelo código de honra, parece trabalhar de graça para os Zoners, que talvez nem saibam.
summary.en: A Solo of unknown identity, gender and funding who has worked Night City for five years and demands in every contract that clients never reveal who they hired. They run extractions, targeted wetwork and retrievals for every major Corp, kill the target saint or sinner, and spare civilians. Their code of honor seems to be why they work free for the Zoners, who may not even know.

summary.en: Captain of South Night City's volunteer fire department, which she built with Forty Mike-Mike from residents and even gangers. A former Petrochem military police officer from the 4th Corporate War, she backs a peaceful movement, but when the NCPD turned heavy weapons on a protest she swapped her teargas for armor-piercing rounds and killed two cops.

She teaches firearms, combat, rescue and even TAC tactics to firefighters and Zoners, and once held off a cyberpsycho for over a minute while residents were rescued. Her real talent is teaching.

summary.en: Head of an artistic porn troupe and Braindance star, who lives on a whole floor of a South Night City housing complex with his harem. He is also a fine shotgun shot and defended the building alone against five gangers sent by Zhirafa, recording it all from his point of view and giving the chips away free.

Aprendeu ativismo e netrunning como operador de computador das cozinhas comunitárias da Night Corp. Prefere soluções não violentas, mas atira bem e usa um balaclava com filtro e granadas de fumaça para cobrir a fuga dos colegas.
summary.en: A Zoners leader who writes much of the movement's messaging, born in the Combat Zone and sibling of Drop of Maelstrom. They picked up activism and Netrunning as a computer operator at Night Corp's soup stations. They favor nonviolent solutions but shoot well, and wear a filter balaclava and throw smoke grenades to cover fellow Zoners' escape.

summary.en: Soldier who deserted during the 4th Corporate War, was presumed dead, and lived in tent camps. He decided to settle in South Night City, where he takes minor security, escort and "delivery" work for Fixers. He seems to be buying up local property and scouting political candidates to support.

She crashed a Chupacabra through the NCPD blockade and let most of the Zoners escape, a move that could cause the Jodes trouble if discovered. She prefers two wheels and automatic weapons.

A gunfighter with a taste for killing and few qualms, he probably hangs with the Zoners to loot protesters' bodies after the police roll in.

She does not share his faith in the Corp and simply does the dirty work, and that indifference may be her weakness.

summary.en: A hard-bitten middle-aged woman in flannel whose thumb really is green. She belongs to the Dirty Hippies and knows hydroponics inside out.

summary.pt: Apresentadora do jornal da noite da Network 54, conhecida por sorrir em qualquer crise. É a obsessão de Lord Ruthven.
summary.en: Evening news anchor for Network 54, known for smiling through any crisis. She is the object of Lord Ruthven's obsession.

summary.pt: Alto, de camisa xadrez e com jeito de interior dos EUA, comanda a oficina de efeitos práticos da produtora das irmãs Senait.
summary.en: A tall, flannel-wearing Midwesterner who manages the practical-effects shop at the Senait Sisters' studio.

summary.pt: Conhecido como Wizard, dirige a Jack ‘N’ the Green, empresa de Reclaimers que opera a partir de Rancho Coronado.
summary.en: Nicknamed the Wizard, he is in charge of Jack ‘N’ the Green, a Reclaimer outfit working from Rancho Coronado.

summary.pt: Chefe do bufê no set da produtora das irmãs Senait. Seu trabalho é manter a equipe alimentada e o elenco satisfeito com pedidos alimentares muitas vezes absurdos.
summary.en: Chief caterer at the Senait Sisters' studio, feeding the crew and humoring a cast whose food demands are often unreasonable.

summary.pt: Vidente de rua neo-hippie que monta barraca em vários Night Markets. Em Haven't Got a Stitch to Wear, a recompensa dela é uma leitura de tarô para um dos personagens, e o conselho pode servir de prévia para as próximas missões.
summary.en: A neo-hippie street psychic who sets up stalls at several Night Markets. In Haven't Got a Stitch to Wear her reward is a Tarot reading for one of the Crew, and her advice is a handy way to hint at missions to come.

summary.pt: Ex-Trauma Team que quase não fala do passado. Montou consultório no Forlorn Hope e conserta ferimentos, biológicos ou cibernéticos, da clientela do bar.
summary.en: A former Trauma Team medic who rarely talks about his past. He set up shop in the Forlorn Hope and patches up the bar's customers, biological or cybernetic injuries alike.

summary.pt: Astro de cinema AAA nascido em Singapura, filho de executivos da Biotechnica e formado na Juilliard. Divorciou-se de Darrel Marchant após uma infidelidade bêbada, foi para a reabilitação e vive de forma discreta, com um segurança só para afastar paparazzi.
summary.en: AAA movie star born in Singapore to Biotechnica corporate parents and a Juilliard graduate. He divorced Darrel Marchant after a drunken affair, went to rehab, and lives modestly with a bodyguard just to keep paparazzi away.

summary.pt: Imigrante somali que transformou um negócio de sucata na Faisal's Customs. Jovem Tech famoso por armas criativas e complexas para clientes particulares, tem corpo de titã graças a uma estrutura linear interna que ele mesmo projetou.
summary.en: A Somali immigrant who turned a salvage business into Faisal's Customs. A young Tech known for clever, complex weapons for private clients, he looks like a titan because of a linear frame he designed and wears under his clothes.

summary.pt: Codiretora, com a irmã Teresa, de dezesseis grandes sucessos de Addiswood. Prefere filmar em locações com elenco local, e os filmes são muito populares na África e na Highrider Confederation.
summary.en: Co-director with her sister Teresa of sixteen Addiswood blockbusters. They prefer shooting on location with local talent, and the films are hugely popular in Africa and the Highrider Confederation.

summary.pt: Fixer magrela, com corpo de corredora, que montou uma rede de ciclistas-mensageiros nos moldes dos dabbawalas de Mumbai do bisavô e entrega por boa parte do submundo de Night City. É ex da ConEx.
summary.en: A wiry Fixer with a distance runner's build who organized a bicycle courier network modeled on her great-grandfather's Mumbai dabbawalas, serving much of Night City's underside. She is ConEx's ex.

summary.pt: Dona do Vargitmmen, um salão viking de araque com "meadery", em Watson. Em A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble, ela é uma das fornecedoras que a Crew pode procurar e tenta empurrar um acordo para vender seu "hidromel" no set.
summary.en: Runs Vargitmmen in Watson, a Viking-themed hall that is mostly show, complete with a "meadery". In A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble she is one of the suppliers the Crew can approach, and she tries to land a deal to sell her "mead" on the film lot.

summary.pt: Engenheiro-executivo da Rocklin Augmentics e pai de Lucy, estudante da Night City University e vítima de uma onda de sequestros. Em A Night at the Opera é quem paga a Crew por meio de um intermediário.
summary.en: An Executive Engineer at Rocklin Augmentics and father of Lucy, a Night City University student caught up in a string of kidnappings. In A Night at the Opera he is the patron who pays the Crew through an intermediary.

summary.pt: Ex-militar e ex-Back Bay Brawler que largou tudo pela música. Venceu um concurso e lidera a banda da casa do Forlorn Hope, com um metal cromático rápido, estridente e potente.
summary.en: An ex-soldier and former Back Bay Brawler who hung it all up for music. She won a contest and now leads the Forlorn Hope's house band with fast, shrill, powerful chromatic metal.

summary.pt: Agente secreta da Arasaka fora do Japão, atualmente em missões nos Estados Unidos.
summary.en: A covert Arasaka agent working outside Japan, currently on assignments in the United States.

summary.pt: Filha de Veronica Stiles e analista de dados da Ziggurat. Gostava de estética gótica e andava com os Sinful Adams. Morreu atropelada ao correr para a rua durante um show improvisado das Digital Divas.
summary.en: Veronica Stiles's daughter and a Ziggurat data analyst. She liked gothic style and ran with the Sinful Adams. She died running into traffic during an impromptu Digital Divas concert.

summary.pt: Pessoa que atua como produtora local em Night City e representa as diretoras de Addiswood, as irmãs Senait. Em A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble deixa um cartão de visita com o número de trabalho, porta de entrada para novos serviços ligados ao filme.
summary.en: A local Night City producer who represents the Addiswood directors the Senait Sisters. In A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble they leave a calling card with a work number, a doorway to more movie-related jobs for the Crew.

summary.pt: Marido da âncora da Network 54 Barbara Dahl, morto em 2044. Em A Night at the Opera, uma checagem DV13 de Criminology, Library Search ou Streetwise revela que a cabeça decepada encontrada pelo grupo era dele.
summary.en: Husband of Network 54 anchor Barbara Dahl, who died in 2044. In A Night at the Opera, a DV13 Criminology, Library Search or Streetwise check reveals that the severed head the Crew finds was his.

summary.pt: Filha mais velha dos Deckard e estudante da NCU, garota-propaganda da Cactus Water. Namorou Raegan Halley e Dillon Murphy; foi morta por Dillon, que depois se matou, e é homenageada em Seral Grove.
summary.en: The eldest Deckard child and an NCU student, spokesmodel for Cactus Water. She dated Raegan Halley and Dillon Murphy; Dillon killed her and then himself, and she is memorialized in Seral Grove.

summary.pt: Técnico de figurino da produtora das irmãs Senait que gosta de acompanhar as fofocas.
summary.en: A costume technician at the Senait Sisters' production company who likes keeping up with gossip.

summary.pt: Jardineira-chefe do Stems & Seeds, coletivo de jardinagem de guerrilha perto da Night City University. Em A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble, a complicação dela é querer um autógrafo de Mael Cartaret.
summary.en: Head gardener at Stems & Seeds, a guerrilla gardening group based near Night City University. In A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble her complication is that she wants Mael Cartaret's autograph.

summary.pt: Tech habilidoso que inventava cyberware para a Arasaka antes da 4ª Guerra Corporativa. Fez muitos inimigos e hoje prefere uma vida isolada, atendendo amigos de amigos com problemas interessantes.
summary.en: A gifted Tech who designed cyberware for Arasaka before the 4th Corporate War. The job earned him many enemies and now prefers isolation, taking jobs from friends of friends with interesting problems.

summary.pt: Fixer de nível médio que trabalha para clientes corporativos como REO Meatwagon, Raven Microcybernetics e Continental Brands. Diz que o apelido vem de sempre pechinchar bem, mas na verdade é bom em arrancar dinheiro do cliente e pagar pouco às equipes.
summary.en: A mid-level Fixer whose Corporate clients include REO Meatwagon, Raven and Continental Brands. He claims the handle comes from his bargain hunting, but really he squeezes clients and underpays his crews.

summary.pt: Estudante de 19 anos da Night City University e a mais recente vítima de uma série de sequestros na região.
summary.en: A 19-year-old NCU student, the newest in a run of local kidnapping victims.

summary.pt: Atriz famosa e protagonista de Parisian Hostess, a nova produção das irmãs Senait. Nos bastidores é conhecida pelo paladar refinado e por insistir em comida orgânica.
summary.en: A well-known movie star and the lead in the Senait Sisters' Parisian Hostess. Behind the scenes she is known for a refined palate and insistence on all-organic food.

summary.pt: Gerente do Delirium, ruivo, sardento e de moicano, que mora no terceiro andar do clube. Os funcionários o chamam de velho rabugento; ele é viciado em Smash e já bebeu até desmaiar.
summary.en: Manager of Delirium, a red-haired, freckled mohawked man who lives on the club's third floor. Staff call him a cranky old grump; he is hooked on Smash and sometimes drinks until he passes out.

summary.pt: Co-dona e bartender-chefe do Forlorn Hope há décadas, de humor ferino. Trata os Edgerunners de que gosta como "seus filhos" e é especialmente maternal, com sarcasmo, com clientes trans.
summary.en: Co-owner and head bartender of the Forlorn Hope for decades, with a wicked sense of humor. She treats the Edgerunners she likes as "her kids" and is, sarcastically, especially motherly to her transgender patrons.

summary.pt: Dono de uma mercearia móvel de comida nipo-americana. A sobrinha dele, Mio, é uma Rockerboy em começo de carreira, com uma banda de crianças adoráveis do ensino fundamental que compõe e lança uma música sobre a Crew como recompensa.
summary.en: Owner of a mobile bodega selling Japanese-American food. His niece Mio is a budding Rockerboy fronting a band of adorable middle-schoolers, and as a reward they write and release a song about the Crew.

summary.pt: Velhinha minúscula de cabelo azul, doutora em entomologia, dona da Myrtle's Mini-Livestock, loja que vende insetos como proteína e para outros usos. Como recompensa dá dois formigueiros em potes de vidro, cheios de formigas furiosas para quebrar na cabeça de alguém.
summary.en: A very small old woman with blue hair and a doctorate in entomology, who runs Myrtle's Mini-Livestock, a shop selling bugs as protein and for other purposes. Her reward is two ant farms in mason jars, full of stinging ants meant to be smashed over somebody's head.

summary.pt: Dona do Nana Meow's Nursery, negócio familiar no baixo Heywood que vende equipamento de aquaponia e sementes. Aparece em A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble como uma das fontes de insumos para a lista de iguarias do set.
summary.en: Runs Nana Meow's Nursery, a business in lower Heywood owned by her family that sells aquaponic equipment and seeds. She shows up in A Bucket of Popcorn-Flavored Kibble as one of the sources for the film set's list of rare delicacies.

summary.pt: Dono da Richard's Remainders, banca de outlet que vende itens encalhados da Vendits. Como recompensa, entrega a um edgerunner um caixote com 5 itens Vendit à escolha do GM.
summary.en: Owner of Richard's Remainders, an outlet stall selling clearance items from Vendits. His reward is a large crate holding 5 Vendit items of the GM's choice.

summary.pt: Ceramista, dona do Coronado Ceramics, estúdio independente que vende em vários Night Markets. As peças levam cacos de para-brisa, dourado de placas de circuito e esmalte de cinza de osso. Como favor a um edgerunner, ela usa os fornos grandes uma vez para sumir com um corpo, sem perguntas, e ainda dá canecas de brinde.
summary.en: A potter who owns Coronado Ceramics, an independent studio that sells at various Night Markets. Her pieces are decorated with broken windshield glass, circuit-board gilding and bone-ash glaze. Once, as a favor to an Edgerunner, she will run her big kilns to dispose of a body, no questions asked, and throws in matching mugs.

summary.pt: Um dos líderes dos Philharmonic Vampyres e aspirante a diretor que quer dar vida nova aos clássicos góticos. Tudo que faz é teatral demais.
summary.en: One of the Philharmonic Vampyres' leaders and an aspiring director who wants to revive the gothic classics. Everything he does is overly theatrical.

summary.pt: Maître do La Lune Bleue, o típico esnobe de berço rico que faz questão de lembrar a todos. O bigodinho e a simpatia dão vontade de bater nele.
summary.en: Maitre'd at La Lune Bleue, the snob from a rich family who makes sure everyone knows it. The pencil mustache and the warm personality make you want to wipe the smugness off him.

summary.pt: Executivo ambicioso da Petrochem que criou a Cactus Water para se livrar de um fracasso. Quando a filha Layla começou a questionar a Corp, mandou o filho Roman resolver, o que terminou em duas mortes. Desertou para a Biotechnica e ganhou uma amante.
summary.en: An ambitious Petrochem executive who invented Cactus Water to escape blame for a failed project. When daughter Layla began questioning the Corp, he sent son Roman to handle it, which ended in two deaths. He defected to Biotechnica and took a new mistress.

summary.pt: Assistente pessoal magro e de cabelo roxo do ator Etan Sim, sempre com um terno cinza discreto.
summary.en: The slender, purple-haired personal assistant of movie star Etan Sim, always in a plain gray suit.

summary.pt: Tech de aparência rústica que trabalha na Bits’n’Bolts e às vezes faz serviços para Faisal.
summary.en: A rough-hewn Tech at Bits’n’Bolts who occasionally does contract work for Faisal.

summary.pt: Filho caçula de Michael e Lilah Deckard. Largou a NCU depois da morte da irmã Layla e passou dias no Delirium atrás de um Netrunner por causa do assédio do Red Knight. A biografia dele e a do Red Knight não batem totalmente entre si.
summary.en: The youngest child of Michael and Lilah Deckard. He dropped out of NCU after sister Layla died and spent days at Delirium looking for a Netrunner to deal with Red Knight's harassment. His biography and Red Knight's do not fully agree.

summary.pt: Fixer e traficante do University District que forneceu drogas e pacotes de Megabite "caídos do caminhão" a Roman Deckard.
summary.en: A Fixer and drug dealer in the University District who supplied Roman Deckard with drugs and Megabite packages that "fell off the truck".

summary.pt: IA de origem desconhecida, talvez um Netrunner Soulkilled ou um R.A.B.I.D. Só quer controle, morte e caos. Depois de saltar de Netrunner em Netrunner, passou a comandar Biodrones por sinal digital e cria cópias menores de si; o original fica no MindNutz Love.
summary.en: An AI of unknown origin, maybe a Soulkilled Netrunner or a R.A.B.I.D. It seems to want only control, death and chaos. After hopping from Netrunner to Netrunner, it now commands Biodrones by digital signal and spawns lesser copies; the original stays at MindNutz Love.

summary.pt: Edgerunner novato, sem reputação, mas capaz de mandar em alguns brutamontes e formar algo parecido com uma equipe.
summary.en: A newbie Edgerunner with no rep, yet enough of a force to boss a few toughs into something like a crew.

summary.pt: Chaveiro que vende segurança aos clientes. Não faz muitas perguntas, mas leva a própria segurança a sério e recusa trabalho se achar que pode levar tiro.
summary.en: A locksmith who sells his clients security. He asks few questions, but he guards his own skin and turns down a lock if he expects gunfire.

summary.pt: Alfaiate da Torrell and Chiang's, magro, bem vestido e de cabelo tingido de azul-esverdeado. Conhecido por alimentar muito bem funcionários e contratados.
summary.en: A tailor at Torrell and Chiang's: slight, well dressed, with blue-green dyed hair. Known for keeping employees and contractors extremely well fed.

summary.pt: Química de rua de cabelo emaranhado e vestido branco, famosa pela pureza das drogas que vende.
summary.en: A stringy-haired street chemist in a white gown, well known for the purity of her drugs.

summary.pt: Codiretora, com a irmã Fanta, de dezesseis grandes sucessos de Addiswood, populares na África e na Highrider Confederation.
summary.en: Co-director with her sister Fanta of sixteen Addiswood blockbusters, hugely popular in Africa and the Highrider Confederation.

summary.pt: Major da Militech, ex-aprendiz de uma wrangler e depois veterana das forças especiais. Perdeu o marido numa operação e a filha Jezz, e, sem apoio dos superiores para a teoria da IA rebelde, gastou economias e favores para destruir o Reaper.
summary.en: A Militech Major, once a wrangler's apprentice and later a special-forces veteran. She lost her husband on an operation and then her daughter Jezz, and with no backing from her superiors for her rogue-AI theory she has spent savings and favors to flatline the Reaper.

summary.pt: Artista de tatuagem de rua, de gênero neutro, e ripperdoc estético que às vezes atende no RC Night Market. Como recompensa, faz um Light Tattoo sob medida para a Crew, ou uma tatuagem tradicional, se preferirem.
summary.en: A gender-neutral tattoo artist from the streets and cosmetic ripperdoc, occasionally found at the RC Night Market. As a reward Vesper will do a custom Light Tattoo for the Crew, or a traditional tattoo if they would rather.

summary.pt: Bartender do Delirium e namorada de Magnus Haggard, punk de cabeça raspada, camiseta branca e jaqueta de couro. Tem carinho por Asher e cobre o vício de Haggard em Smash.
summary.en: Delirium bartender and Magnus Haggard's girlfriend, a buzz-cut punk in white tees and leather jackets. She has a soft spot for Asher and covers for Haggard's Smash addiction.

summary.pt: Netrunner que comanda a equipe de ataque de Hack Attack na conversão do Jumpstart Kit. Também pode voltar como uma das assassinas que um Fixer contrata para punir uma Crew traidora.
summary.en: Netrunner who heads the strike team in Hack Attack in the Jumpstart Kit conversion. She can also return as one of the assassins a Fixer hires to punish a crew that double-crosses them.

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Netrunner com Interface 4. A ficha traz o deck e os programas já carregados.
text.en: Netrunner Role Ability at Interface 4. The sheet lists her deck and the programs already loaded.

text.pt: Tenente, no mesmo nível de Dorothy.
text.en: Lieutenant, the same tier as Dorothy.

summary.pt: Tech vaidosa e cheia de estilo que lidera a gangue Yellow Brick Road no cenário Definitely Not Kansas da conversão do Jumpstart Kit. O guia lhe dá uma NET Architecture privada própria.
summary.en: Stylish, fashion-obsessed Tech who leads the Yellow Brick Road gang in the Definitely Not Kansas scenario of the Jumpstart Kit conversion. The guide gives her a private NET Architecture of her own.

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Tech (Maker 4) com Fabrication Expertise 4 e Field Expertise 4.
text.en: Tech Role Ability (Maker 4) with Fabrication Expertise 4 and Field Expertise 4.

text.pt: Tenente, no mesmo nível de Crunch.
text.en: Lieutenant, the same tier as Crunch.

summary.pt: Médico e tech que a conversão sugere como dono do prédio de The Apartment, alugando estúdios aos PCs por 1.500eb ao mês. Se o prédio sobreviver, perdoa o mês seguinte e costura a Crew de graça.
summary.en: Doctor and tinkerer whom the conversion proposes as the owner of The Apartment's building, renting studios to the PCs at 1,500eb a month. If the building survives he waives next month's rent and patches the Crew up for free.

weapons.name: Stun Gun
weapons.notes: Exotic Heavy Pistol; a hit that would drop the target below 1 HP leaves them Unconscious at 1 HP

text.pt: Medicine 2 com Surgery Base 12 (valor impresso na linha de Role) e Maker 2 com Fabrication Expertise 2 e Field Expertise 2.
text.en: Medicine 2 with Surgery Base 12 (printed on the Role line) and Maker 2 with Fabrication Expertise 2 and Field Expertise 2.

text.pt: Tenente, junto com Gina Zeppada.
text.en: Lieutenant, alongside Gina Zeppada.

summary.pt: Vizinha Nomad do prédio de The Apartment, que a conversão manda apresentar aos PCs em vez de sorteá-la. Uma cena sugerida é ajudá-la a subir as compras até o apartamento.
summary.en: Nomad neighbor in The Apartment's building whom the conversion has the GM introduce to the PCs rather than roll up. One suggested scene is helping her carry groceries upstairs.

sheetNote.pt: O livro imprime "Language (Education)" na lista de perícias dela, provável erro de impressão. Mantido como impresso.
sheetNote.en: The book prints "Language (Education)" in her skill list, probably a typo. Kept as printed.

gear: Roadbike w/ Bulletproof Glass x2 and NOS

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Nomad (Moto 4).
text.en: Nomad Role Ability (Moto 4).

text.pt: Tenente, junto com o Dr. George Carver.
text.en: Lieutenant, alongside Dr. George Carver.

summary.pt: Vizinho Solo de The Apartment, parceiro de cerveja no bar do bairro. A conversão só quer que ele traia a Crew em It's Just Business se houver um Solo entre os jogadores.
summary.en: Solo neighbor in The Apartment, a beer buddy at the local bar. The conversion only has him betray the Crew in It's Just Business when a Solo is among the players.

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Solo (Combat Awareness 4).
text.en: Solo Role Ability (Combat Awareness 4).

text.pt: A Heavy Armorjack reduz REF, DEX e MOVE e as perícias ligadas a eles; a ficha imprime o valor com a penalidade entre parênteses.
text.en: The Heavy Armorjack lowers REF, DEX and MOVE and the skills tied to them; the sheet prints the penalized value in parentheses.

text.pt: Tenente Endurecido (Hardened Lieutenant).
text.en: Hardened Lieutenant.

summary.pt: Fixer à frente da família Anderson, vizinhos de The Apartment que usam o statblock de Boosterganger. Reaparece como a vendedora de equipamento extra em Black Chrome+ (Interface RED Volume 4).
summary.en: Fixer at the head of the Anderson family, The Apartment's neighbors who use the Boosterganger statblock. She returns as the seller of bonus gear in Black Chrome+ (Interface RED Volume 4).

sheetNote.pt: Black Chrome imprime uma versão diferente: Operator 6, REP 5, Shuriken Tornado Grenade (6d6) e a jaqueta Tech Upgraded Laser Light St (SP 12). Esta ficha segue a de Interface RED Volume 2, mais recente.
sheetNote.en: Black Chrome prints a different version: Operator 6, REP 5, a Shuriken Tornado Grenade (6d6) and a Tech Upgraded Laser Light St Jacket (SP 12). This sheet follows Interface RED Volume 2, the more recent book.

weapons.name: Light Melee Weapon
weapons.notes: No Skill Base printed for this weapon; STAT only.

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Fixer (Operator 4).
text.en: Fixer Role Ability (Operator 4).

text.pt: Tenente.
text.en: Lieutenant.

summary.pt: Policial da simulação de academia em Just Like Real, que entrega à Crew um Rocket Launcher de qualidade excelente com um único foguete. O guia fornece a ficha caso ele precise aparecer de novo.
summary.en: Police officer of the academy simulation in Just Like Real, who hands the Crew an Excellent Quality Rocket Launcher with a single rocket. The guide supplies his sheet in case he is needed again.

gear: Armor Piercing Very Heavy Pistol Ammo x8

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Lawman (Backup 4).
text.en: Lawman Role Ability (Backup 4).

text.pt: Tenente Endurecido (Hardened Lieutenant).
text.en: Hardened Lieutenant.

summary.pt: Rockerboy vizinho em The Apartment, conhecido pelo nome artístico. A conversão sugere cenas como a Crew fazendo a segurança de um de seus shows.
summary.en: Rockerboy neighbor in The Apartment, known by his stage name. The conversion suggests scenes such as the Crew working security at one of his gigs.

sheetNote.pt: A ficha imprime "Melee Weapons" (no plural) na lista de perícias. Mantido como impresso.
sheetNote.en: The sheet prints "Melee Weapons" (plural) in the skill list. Kept as printed.

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Rockerboy (Charismatic Impact 4).
text.en: Rockerboy Role Ability (Charismatic Impact 4).

text.pt: Tenente.
text.en: Lieutenant.

summary.pt: Solo que comanda a equipe de ataque de Unknown Caller, com Security Operatives de Light Armorjack e uma tirolesa. Se virar antagonista fixo, escapa pela janela amortecendo a queda com as cyberlegs.
summary.en: Solo who commands the strike team in Unknown Caller, backed by Security Operatives in Light Armorjack and a zipline. If kept as a recurring antagonist he escapes through a window, cushioning the fall with his cyberlegs.

sheetNote.pt: A ficha imprime "Melee Weapons" (no plural) na lista de perícias. Mantido como impresso.
sheetNote.en: The sheet prints "Melee Weapons" (plural) in the skill list. Kept as printed.

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Solo (Combat Awareness 4).
text.en: Solo Role Ability (Combat Awareness 4).

text.pt: Sua equipe é ele mais Security Operatives de Light Armorjack com Autofire 12. Notá-lo antes que revele a posição exige Perception DV17.
text.en: His crew is Security Operatives in Light Armorjack with Autofire 12, plus himself. Catching sight of him before he reveals where he stands is a DV17 Perception Check.

text.pt: Tenente Endurecido (Hardened Lieutenant).
text.en: Hardened Lieutenant.

summary.pt: Policial da simulação de Just Like Real, que aparece num Gyrocopter com chassi blindado (SP13) durante a invasão final. O guia dá uma ficha própria para ele.
summary.en: Cop of the simulation in Just Like Real, who turns up in a Gyrocopter with Armored Chassis (SP13) during the final raid. The guide gives him his own statblock.

Stun Baton
weapons.notes: No Skill Base printed for this weapon; STAT only.

gear: Smart Glasses w/ Targeting Scope and TeleOptics

text.pt: Habilidade de Role Lawman (Backup 4).
text.en: Lawman Role Ability (Backup 4).

text.pt: Tenente Endurecido (Hardened Lieutenant).
text.en: Hardened Lieutenant.

summary.pt: Vendedor de cyberdecks e hardware do Midnight Market, com quatro olhos cibernéticos e um terceiro cyberarm saindo do colarinho. Compra gravações de flatline e circula o boato de ser cultista de R.A.B.I.D.S. ou agente infiltrado da Netwatch.
summary.en: Cyberdeck and hardware dealer at the Midnight Market, with four cybereyes and a third cyberarm rising from the collar. He buys flatline recordings, and rumor has him as either a R.A.B.I.D.S. cultist or an undercover Netwatch agent.

summary.pt: Ex-ciberpsicopata e Medtech expulsa dos Dragula Racers, que vira obcecada por TSpooks e forja o falso lobisomem de Watson para impulsionar a carreira dela. Quando a Crew se aproxima da influenciadora, ela ataca por ciúme.
summary.en: Former cyberpsycho and Medtech, kicked out of the Dragula Racers, who fixates on TSpooks and stages the fake Watson werewolf to boost her career. When the Crew gets close to the influencer, she attacks out of jealousy.

summary.pt: Assistente de legista do Precinct #3 que descobre que o lobisomem de Watson era um homem mutilado por bodysculpt e é pressionada a arquivar a morte como acidente. Paga a Crew com o fundo do necrotério para seguir as pistas que ela reuniu.
summary.en: Assistant coroner at Precinct #3 who finds the Watson werewolf was a man ruined by bad bodysculpting, then gets pushed to file his death as an accident. She pays the Crew from the morgue's discretionary funds to chase the leads she gathered.

summary.pt: Influenciadora de conteúdo paranormal que trabalha de zeladora no turno da noite do Megabuilding H10. O vídeo do falso lobisomem virou o de maior audiência dela, mas ela não quer construir a carreira em cima de uma mentira e planeja desmentir o caso.
summary.en: Paranormal influencer who works second-shift custodian at Megabuilding H10. The fake-werewolf video became her highest rated, but she refuses to base her career on a hoax and plans to expose it.

summary.pt: Líder miúda e pálida dos Dragula Racers, gogang de bodysculpt de monstros e corrida de carro funerário turbinado. Ajuda a Crew por ser prima de Amani e conta que a gangue expulsou Sparkle Skull por gastar o caixa em cartões do Oasis.
summary.en: Short, pale leader of the Dragula Racers, a gogang built around monster bodysculpts and tuned-up hearse racing. She assists the Crew since her cousin is Amani, and tells them the gang expelled Sparkle Skull for blowing the treasury on Oasis gift cards.

summary.pt: Veterano sem-teto da 4ª Guerra Corporativa, ex-Militech, transformado no falso lobisomem de Watson com bodysculpt e um Audiovox que só emite uivos. Morre baleado por seguranças de folga da SovOil, mas já estava condenado pelas infecções.
summary.en: Homeless 4th Corporate War veteran and former Militech employee, turned into the fake Watson werewolf through bodysculpting and an Audiovox that only howls. He dies shot by off-duty SovOil security, though his infections would have killed him anyway.

summary.pt: Líder de guerra dos Sinful Adams, a gangue goth do Boneyard. Contrata a Crew como segurança extra do Carnaval de Halloween, pedindo o mínimo de força para expulsar os Philharmonic Vampyres, e fica ocupada com as lutas do Ring of Wrath.
summary.en: War-leader of the Sinful Adams, the goth gang of the Boneyard. She hires the Crew as extra security for the Halloween Carnival, asking for as little force as possible in driving off the Philharmonic Vampyres, while she runs the Ring of Wrath bouts.

summary.pt: Fixer de Little Europe que toca o Night Market dele no andar de cima do Short Circuit, o bar que ele tem com o marido, Brain, e a filha, Bug. Vende só equipamento de tech, decks e programas completos e revisados, e quem decide quem entra é a pequena Bug. Também apresenta um canal sobre finanças na Garden.
summary.en: A Little Europe Fixer who runs his Night Market upstairs from Short Circuit, the family bar co-owned by Brain, his spouse, and their kid Bug. He sells tech, decks and programs that are always complete and refurbished, and little Bug decides who gets in. He also hosts a finance channel on the Garden.

summary.pt: Fixer de Rancho Coronado conhecida pelo bodysculpt de feições de pássaro. Faz o Night Market dela, todo dia 5, no antigo shopping Minimallism, inspirada nos bazares que a avó descrevia em Mumbai: roupas sob medida, comida e convidados escolhidos a dedo.
summary.en: A Rancho Coronado Fixer known for her bird-like bodysculpt. She holds her Night Market on the fifth of every month in the old Minimallism mall, modeled on the bazaars her grandmother described in Mumbai: tailored clothes, food and carefully chosen guests.

summary.pt: Marido de 3-Piece e coproprietário do Short Circuit. No térreo ele serve drinks e recolhe fofoca; no vídeo de 3-Piece sobre Agents, explica com empolgação como o brinquedo da Segotari virou o assistente que todo mundo carrega.
summary.en: 3-Piece's husband and co-owner of Short Circuit. On the ground floor he pours drinks and collects gossip; in 3-Piece's video on Agents he happily lays out how a Segotari toy became the assistant everyone carries.

summary.pt: Lutadora lendária da EWL, a Red Comet, que também foi gladiadora, consultora policial e herói de uma vid da Garden. Hoje é dona do bar VA-11 HALL-A por uma franquia da Hammered Industries e tenta viver discreta, mas ainda é uma Solo capaz de dar trabalho a um esquadrão inteiro. Adora qualquer coisa fofa e não resiste a enfiar a cabeça em objetos esquisitos.
summary.en: Legendary EWL wrestler known as the Red Comet, who has also been a gladiator, a police consultant and the hero of a Garden vid. She now owns the bar VA-11 HALL-A through a Hammered Industries franchise and tries to keep a low profile, yet she is still a Solo who can keep a whole squad busy. She loves anything cute and cannot help sticking her head into odd objects.

summary.pt: Netrunner de aluguel da Pacifica Confederation, criada numa família comum e estável. Trabalha sobretudo como consultora de segurança, mas também aceita serviços de black hat. A Danger Gal a vê como suspeita de ser a ativista Alice_Rabbit, embora ela critique esse tipo de hacker em público.
summary.en: A hired Netrunner in the Pacifica Confederation, raised in an ordinary and stable family. She mostly works as a security consultant but also takes black-hat gigs. Danger Gal lists her as a suspect for the activist Alice_Rabbit, even though she loudly criticizes that kind of hacker.

summary.pt: Ex-White Knight da Valkyrie Squad. Quando criança foi ferida no parque por um policial da MAX-TAC em surto, no mesmo ataque que custou um olho a Stella Hoshii, e entrou nos White Knights em homenagem a quem a salvou. Escapou das acusações quando o grupo foi exposto e hoje é guarda-costas de Stella.
summary.en: Former White Knight of Valkyrie Squad. As a child she was hurt in a park by a MAX-TAC officer in the middle of a breakdown, in the same attack that cost Stella Hoshii an eye, and she joined the White Knights to honor her rescuer. She was cleared when the group was exposed and now works as Stella's bodyguard.

summary.en: A sex worker in an FBC body, rescued by Danger Gal out of a cult built around an AI and its chrome bodies and later taken in by Millicent Graem, who calls her Becky. Cheerful, far from naive, and the owner of MIRD113 gun hands, she is also a loyal friend to Jill.

text.pt: Nesta versão de Night City ela é uma Full Body Conversion, ou seja, um cérebro humano num corpo totalmente cibernético (regras em Interface RED Volume 3).
text.en: In this version of Night City she is a Full Body Conversion, a human brain in an otherwise fully cybernetic body (rules in Interface RED Volume 3).

summary.pt: Uma das duas bartenders do VA-11 HALL-A e filha de uma violinista de concerto. Largou uma oferta de pesquisa da Biotechnica e terminou com a namorada, e agora tem uma queda pela chefe, Dana Zane. É ótima de conversa e inútil como fonte: nunca conta nada sobre os clientes.
summary.en: One of VA-11 HALL-A's two bartenders and the daughter of a concert violinist. She passed up a research offer from Biotechnica, split with her girlfriend, and now has a thing for her boss, Dana Zane. She excels at conversation but is useless as a source, since she never discusses the customers.

sheetNote.pt: A ficha imprime só uma linha de armadura, Kevlar® SP 7, depois de um traço na primeira; entrou como armadura de corpo.
sheetNote.en: The sheet prints a single armor line, Kevlar® SP 7, after a dash on the first row; it is entered as body armor.

summary.pt: Filha de um alto executivo da Night Corp que nasceu como exótica por causa da cura genética para uma síndrome rara. Perdeu um olho no mesmo ataque que feriu Sei Asagiri, cuja versão oficial a MAX-TAC maquiou. Hoje é bem ajustada, generosa, faz caridade e vai disfarçada aos shows de Kira Miki.
summary.en: Daughter of a senior Night Corp exec, born an Exotic because of the genetic cure for a rare syndrome. She lost an eye in the same attack that hurt Sei Asagiri, whose official story MAX-TAC covered up. Today she is well adjusted and generous, does charity work and sneaks into Kira Miki concerts in disguise.

summary.pt: Empresário rico que construiu a fortuna viajando e fechando negócios arriscados e hoje é dono e editor-chefe do Augmented Eye, o segundo screamsheet mais vendido da cidade. Machista e abusivo com os funcionários, insiste que Jill escreveria uma ótima coluna de fofocas sobre a clientela do bar.
summary.en: Rich businessman whose money came from travelling and striking risky deals; he now owns and edits the Augmented Eye, the second-best-selling screamsheet in the city. Sexist and abusive toward his employees, he keeps pressing the point that Jill could produce a terrific gossip column on the bar's clientele.

summary.pt: Edgerunner especializado em contratos de eliminação, que prefere ser chamado de caçador de recompensas. Muito aprimorado com chrome, aparenta perder memória e sabe que anda perto da ciberpsicose; escolhe o bar porque a dona dá conta de qualquer encrenca.
summary.en: An Edgerunner whose specialty is wetwork contracts, though he would rather be called a bounty hunter. Heavily chromed, he seems to be losing memories and knows he is close to cyberpsychosis; he picks this bar because its owner can handle any trouble.

summary.pt: Ídolo full-borg e superstar que passa pelo VA-11 HALL-A quando vem à cidade para um show. Gosta de Jill, a ponto de dedicar uma música a ela, e acredita de verdade que ídolos mudam o mundo pela sinceridade.
summary.en: Full-borg idol and superstar who drops by VA-11 HALL-A whenever she is in town for a concert. She is fond of Jill, even dedicating a song to her, and sincerely believes idols can change the world through honesty.

summary.pt: Exótico canino extremo, esculpido e programado com chips de comportamento para ser o mais parecido possível com um cão. O nome é apelido de Dana Zane por causa dos óculos escuros e da camisa tropical, e ele atua como mascote não oficial do bar para arrecadar fundos para a CIRA.
summary.en: Extreme canine Exotic, sculpted and fitted with behavior chips to be as dog-like as possible. The name is a nickname from Dana Zane, inspired by his sunglasses and tropical shirt, and he works as the bar's unofficial mascot to raise money for the CIRA.

summary.pt: O segundo bartender do VA-11 HALL-A, chamado de Gil ou Gillian por Jill e por Zane. É um mistério: tem jeito de ex-soldado ou policial, talvez foragido na China, e Zane o protege com muito zelo.
summary.en: VA-11 HALL-A's second bartender, called Gil or Gillian by Jill and Zane. He is a mystery: he seems a former soldier or cop, possibly on the run from China, and Zane is fiercely protective of him.

summary.pt: Streamer que transmite a vida 24 horas e guarda o conteúdo mais picante atrás de uma assinatura paga. Sua audiência sobe quando visita o VA-11 HALL-A, então aparece sempre; tornou-se próxima de Dorothy Haze e é patrocinada pela Shining Finger.
summary.en: Streamer who broadcasts her life nonstop and puts the racier content behind a subscription. Her viewership jumps whenever she visits the VA-11 HALL-A bar, which is why she keeps turning up to pester the staff; she has gotten close to Dorothy Haze and is sponsored by Shining Finger.

summary.pt: Um dos cinco "cérebros engarrafados" de Night City, parte do projeto Sola Anima da Biotechnica com a Night City University. O cérebro vive num Biosystem aprimorado que permite se mover e interagir, e Taylor ainda escreveu o best-seller The Last Rain in the World.
summary.en: One of five "bottled brains" in Night City, a product of the Sola Anima project, which Biotechnica runs with Night City University. The brain lives in an upgraded Biosystem that allows movement and interaction, and Taylor also wrote the bestseller The Last Rain in the World.

summary.pt: Ganger da Maelstrom com mais de dois metros de altura e vários olhos vermelhos brilhantes, que toma o bar Bouncing Benny's para festejar o aniversário com karaokê. Não está no topo da gangue, mas os outros a seguem e ela comemora cada golpe como se fosse um presente.
summary.en: Maelstrom ganger well over two meters tall with several glowing red eyes, who takes over Bouncing Benny's to celebrate her birthday with karaoke. She is not high in the gang, but the others follow her lead and she cheers every hit like a gift.

summary.en: A newly full Maelstrom member left guarding the door of Bouncing Benny's during Nitro's party. He would rather be inside, but fears his own gang more than strangers, and a 100 eddie bribe can make him look away.

summary.pt: Netrunner da MoorE Technologies e amante ocasional do executivo Roger Kynard. Prefere entregar o data shard ao empregador a preservar o caso, e leva um grupo de hustle ao estacionamento de Rancho Coronado para tomá-lo. Luta de trás de cobertura com Quickhacks e foge se for ferido gravemente.
summary.en: Netrunner for MoorE Technologies and occasional lover of the executive Roger Kynard. He would rather hand the data shard to his employer than keep the affair, and brings a group of hustle to the Rancho Coronado parking lot to take it. He fights from cover with Quickhacks and flees if badly hurt.

text.en: Role Rank 3, with Interface 3 and 2 Net Actions per Turn.

text.en: A Cyberdeck built into his Neuroport gives him access to Quickhacks.

summary.pt: Dono do Bouncing Benny's, bar de Northside, que achou o data shard esquecido por Roger Kynard e planeja vendê-lo para levantar uns eddies. Não é lutador: se a coisa esquenta, se esconde no escritório e deixa a Maelstrom resolver.
summary.en: Owner of Bouncing Benny's, a Northside bar, who found the data shard Roger Kynard dropped and plans to sell it for quick eddies. He is no fighter: when things heat up he hides in his office and lets the Maelstrom sort it out.

summary.pt: Ex-nômade que deixou a família para tentar a sorte como cantora em Night City e hoje serve no Bouncing Benny's. Não é da Maelstrom e pode ajudar o grupo se receber um bom motivo, mas nunca se expõe a perigo real e foge de moto assim que os tiros começam.
summary.en: Former Nomad who left her family to try making it as a singer in Night City and now tends bar at Bouncing Benny's. She is not Maelstrom and may help the crew for a good reason, but she never risks real danger and rides off the moment shooting starts.

summary.pt: Executivo da Dynalar que perdeu um data shard criptografado com dados sigilosos num bar de Northside e pagou à fixer Regina Jones para recuperá-lo. Espera o grupo num estacionamento em Rancho Coronado, onde o amante, Rocky, tenta tomar o chip.
summary.en: Dynalar executive who left an encrypted data shard full of confidential company data in a Northside bar, then hired the Fixer Regina Jones to fetch it. He meets the crew at a Rancho Coronado parking lot, where his lover Rocky tries to grab the chip.

summary.pt: Colecionador de armas que vive nos esgotos sob a borda oeste da Hot Zone e toca sozinho o The Temple, um estande de tiro com pista de obstáculos para testar armas antes de comprar. Herdou o acervo da mãe, morta por ciberpsicose, e jura que golfinhos e orcas manipulam corporações, governos e a NET.
summary.en: Gun collector who lives in the sewers under the western edge of the Hot Zone and runs The Temple alone, a firing range with an obstacle course for trying weapons before buying. He inherited his mother's collection after she died of cyberpsychosis, and swears dolphins and orcas pull the strings of corporations, governments and the NET.

summary.pt: Jornalista que apresenta o Rebuilding Night City, programa da rede KLIA Garden Patch sobre a reconstrução lenta da cidade. Entrevista gente fora do comum, de um colecionador paranoico de armas a um fabricante de bicicletas, e se acostumou a ser recebida com arma na cara.
summary.en: Journalist who hosts Rebuilding Night City, a KLIA Garden Patch Network show about the city's slow reconstruction. She interviews unusual people, from a paranoid gun collector to a bicycle maker, and has grown used to being greeted with a gun in her face.

summary.pt: Jornalista freelancer que já escreveu para vários screamsheets, incluindo o Night City Today News, e passou a cobrir notícias de empresas na The Glen antes de lançar a Garden Patch independente Today At The Source. A primeira série trata de armas e começa com Woodchipper.
summary.en: Freelance journalist who has written for several screamsheets, including Night City Today News, and covered the corporate beat in The Glen before launching the independent Garden Patch Today At The Source. The first series is about guns and starts with Woodchipper.

summary.pt: Fundador da Yang's Wheels, de uma Pack nômade da Snake Nation que deixou a cidade enquanto ele ficou. Largou a construção civil para fabricar bicicletas, skates e patins baratos, com a engenheira-chefe Edith Lamarr, e já planeja levar a mesma ideia ao transporte público.
summary.en: Founder of Yang's Wheels, from a Snake Nation Nomad Pack that left the city while he stayed behind. He quit construction work to build cheap bicycles, skateboards and inline skates with Chief Engineer Edith Lamarr, and is already planning to bring the same idea to public transport.

summary.pt: Vendedor de cyberware que grita seus anúncios como "Mr. A-MAAAZE"; o nome verdadeiro é William Maze. Toca a House of MAAAZE no Dock 13, em South Night City, e vive tentando enfiar o produto em quem passa. Os anúncios dele terminam com o microfone ainda aberto.
summary.en: Cyberware seller who shouts his ads as "Mr. A-MAAAZE"; his real name is William Maze. He runs the House of MAAAZE at Dock 13 in South Night City and keeps pushing product on everyone who walks by. His ads tend to end with the mic still open.

summary.pt: Apresentadora que se define como entusiasta de ração de pasta de amendoim e "Demônio" certificado da Segotari Station no Playland by the Sea. Faz listas retrospectivas dos melhores jogos de cada geração da Segotari, montadas a partir de enquetes na própria Garden Patch.
summary.en: Host who calls herself a Peanut Butter Kibble enthusiast and holds a "Demon" certification at the Segotari Station in Playland by the Sea. She makes retrospective lists of the best games from each Segotari generation, compiled from surveys on her own Garden Patch.
